label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. I believe this
marks
our
first
interaction
in
this
clubroom.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_02
text: I hope your Agias hasn’t suffered any...\naftereffects from the other day?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_01
text: Nah, it’s doing great!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_02
text: We’ve been flying a lot!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_03
text: That is a relief.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_04
text: Seeing it consume such a quantity of that\nsupplement caused me some concern.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_05
text: Perhaps Agias’s sturdy constitution has shielded it\nfrom any ill effects.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_06
text: I suspect it would be dangerous to let any other\nPokémon eat as much of the supplement.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_07
text: Since I usually ride my Skarmory for the Flying\nTime Trial, I have not had the opportunity to test\r\nsuch matters myself.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_08
text: I have nothing else to report. Let us conclude this\nconversation.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_00
text: I have a question, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_01
text: How was it that you and Kieran first met?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_01
text: On a school trip!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_02
text: We paired up!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02
text: So it was a trip that started it all?\c\nI do recall that Kieran and Carmine returned to\nKitakami shortly before Kieran’s...change.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02b
text:
P-paired?!\c
...Ahem. Pardon me.\c
I understand now that you mean you undertook
your school trip activities as a pair.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_03
text: I have been wondering why your presence\nprovoked such intense reactions from Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_04
text: Based on what you’ve said, I doubt that the\ncircumstances of your meeting were the cause.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_05
text: My question is answered. Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], I would like to
consult
you
on
something.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_01
text: Lately, I feel that...something is the matter with\nme.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_02
text: I sometimes feel an ache within my chest, and my\nappetite is dampened.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_03
text: But when I go to the nurse’s office, I am told that\nnothing is amiss.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_04
text: Is it possible that my symptoms are the result\nof some sort of physiological change?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_01
text: Any ideas what it could be?

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_02
text: When do your symptoms occur?

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05
text: I have no idea whatsoever.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05b
text: They occur with no regularity whatsoever.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_06
text: I suppose the sole common factor is that...these\nsymptoms arise when I think of Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_07
text: But surely no causal relationship can be found\nthere.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_00
text: I note that my symptoms have abated during\nour conversation, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_01
text: It may be that speaking with you has a\ntherapeutic effect.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_02
text: In order to test this hypothesis, I propose that we\ntrade Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_03
text: Your consent is appreciated. I choose to offer\na Skarmory. I await your choice.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] is...wonderful. Thank you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nI will raise this Pokémon with great care.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You will trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for\nmy\r\nSkarmory?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Amarys a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Amarys such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Amarys a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_03_00
text:
Ah, wait. Trading cannot proceed as long as you
have only one Pokémon on hand.\c
Please put two or more Pokémon in your party so
that we may advance proceedings.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_03_01
text: ...Refusal acknowledged.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_04_00
text: My proposal to trade Pokémon still stands.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_talkto_00
text: I propose a battle. Do you accept?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_cancel_00
text: ...Refusal acknowledged.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_00
text: Then let us relocate to the court. Come with me.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_01
text: At this institution, Double Battles are standard.\nI suggest that you bring at least two Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_00
text: Congratulations on your victory.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_01
text: Battling you always brings me a certain sense\nof tranquility.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_02
text: Allow me to express my gratitude by passing on\nthe most powerful technique I know.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_03
text: Carmine taught this to me...\c\nShe said that if you assume this pose, victory\nover your opponent is instantly assured.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_reward_00
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Finger Heart emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from\nAmarys!

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_01_00
text: Congratulations on your victory.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_01_01
text: Time for me to go. So long, then.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_lose_00_00
text: Victory belongs to me. Well fought.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_00
text: Time is finite. Every second of every minute must\nbe used with great care.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_01
text: Yes, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]? What is it?\c\nHas my fine taste in eyeglasses caught your\nattention?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_02
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]With you around, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], I
can
rest
assured
that
Kieran
is
in
good hands.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me is\nwonderful.\r\nTruly wonderful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_04
text:
I should mention that the Skarmory I traded you
is inside a Heavy Ball.\c
This ball is well suited to Steel-type Pokémon in
both function and design. It truly is beautiful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
